Pour ne pas prêter un personnage au visage d'une autre actrice, les slides des personnages sont des photos sans visage. Place micabo : slide 5 (se tester). would these famous fictional students really be
good study role models? my honest review

lisa simpson
+ loves learning, reads everything, always prepared
− takes every bad grade very hard
verdict: role model, with more self-kindness

velma dinkley
+ solves everything with research and clues
+ stays calm when everyone panics
verdict: role model. be the one who checks the facts.

belle
+ reads for fun, curious about the whole world
− not much of a study schedule
verdict: copy her curiosity, add a planner

my takeaway: curious like belle, calm like velma,
and quiz yourself on your notes like lisa would.
and like all of them: no scrolling during study time.
